task: Distribute CoProgrammer collaboration skills across portable Agent Plugins clients and Claude Code
intent: Make the existing five workflows installable through a shared package and Claude marketplace, while accurately documenting the CLI prerequisite and next evidence-integrity milestone.
core_changes: Add Agent Plugins 1.0 and Claude Code plugin manifests for the existing skills.
Add native Claude Code and Codex marketplace catalogs at the repository root.
Use the installed coprogrammer CLI in packaged skill instructions.
Document current distribution state and source-backed evidence-freshness research.
contracts: Claude Code plugin manifest and marketplace entry
Codex repo marketplace entry with a contained local source
tests: Run the full unittest suite, including plugin and marketplace path checks.
Validate the portable manifest against Agent Plugins 1.0.0.
Run Claude Code plugin validation when the CLI is available.
Run repository configuration and change-manifest validation.
risks: Agent Plugins support varies by client surface; the package currently contains skills only.
The CLI and MCP server are not bundled; this change does not publish the branch version to PyPI.
The Claude marketplace is a third-party marketplace and consumers should review plugin contents before installation.
